summary.en-US: Configurable publisher watchlists and formal post-publication signals for scholarly literature.

version.approval_notes: Notandia’s first Firefox release uses Gecko ID browser-extension@notandia.github.io. The source package is readable, with no minification, remote code, runtime npm dependencies or telemetry. Publisher and journal warnings run locally using bundled Wikimedia snapshots (CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution included). Manual publisher profiles and import/export remain available. Crossref and NCBI requests are off by default; the setup prompt offers activation or individual choices. Firefox optional websiteContent permission is required for either provider. Crossref receives DOI identifiers; NCBI receives DOI, PMID or PMCID identifiers and public application contact metadata. Requests omit cookies and referrers. Turning off a provider stops its requests. Pages, citation text, search queries and browsing history stay local. Privacy policy: https://notandia.pages.dev/privacy/firefox/
